Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification

Hi Alex / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking the call just now. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Call recap:
- Workload: customer-facing summarization + assistant (mix of long prompts + streaming).
- Current baseline: ~120M tokens/day average, peaks ~220M tokens/day (30% of requests are long-context).
- Latency target: P95 < 300ms for interactive flows; batch jobs can be higher.

Commercial ask from you: confirm target unit economics (you mentioned a target of ~$8 per 1M tokens) and a monthly budget range so Marcus/ops can propose an appropriate Dedicated configuration.

Technical questions for sizing:
- Preferred GPU family (A100 vs H100) given latency/throughput tradeoffs?
- Do you prefer reserved slot count or a guaranteed throughput (tokens/s) guarantee?
- Any hard compliance/network constraints for a Private deployment?

What I’ll do next:
- Marcus will propose 2 capacity options (cost-first and performance-first) with estimated $/1M tokens and throughput.
- I’ll follow up with a short MA P (mutual action plan) and calendar for a sizing call this week.

Attached: pricing-model.xlsx (working spreadsheet for slot counts & unit economics).

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Alex Johnson <alex@finlytics.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:10:43 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. Confirmation and some numbers from our side: 

- Typical daily: 120M tokens/day (as mentioned) — this is our current production average. Expected growth ~20% Q/Q.
- Peak day: ~220M tokens/day, with a peak-hour QPS equivalent that translates to ~3.1k concurrent token generation (varies by prompt).
- Latency SLO: P95 <= 300ms for chat flows is important. We can tolerate up to 500ms for some assistant tasks.
- Budget: target range $12k–$20k / month to start. We’re incentive-aligned to get cost down with volume.
- Target unit economics: we’re aiming for <= $10 per 1M tokens, ideally closer to $7–8 if possible.

On GPU preference: we don’t have a hard preference but care most about predictable latency. If H100 substantially improves latency for long-context workloads, we’d consider it.

Next steps: happy to take Marcus’s options. We can do a 30-min follow-up tomorrow (Thu) morning.

— Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of AI Products | Finlytics
alex@finlytics.com | +1 (646) 555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 17:00:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing qualification

Alex / Marissa —

Thanks Alex for the clarity. Based on the volumes and latency SLO, here are two preliminary Dedicated configurations and rough unit economics (ballpark, subject to final benchmarking):

Option A — Cost-first (4x A100 80GB reserved)
- Reserved: 4x NVIDIA A100 80GB (shared across models, continuous batching enabled)
- Estimated sustainable throughput: ~2.5k tokens/sec aggregate (depends on prompt length distribution)
- Expected P95 latency: ~250–350ms for interactive flows at target batching
- Estimated list cost: $14k/month (Redwood committed + infra)
- Implied unit cost: ~$9–$11 per 1M tokens at 120M–220M token/day profiles (economies of scale reduce to low end with higher steady volume)

Option B — Performance-first (2x H100 80GB reserved + burst)
- Reserved: 2x NVIDIA H100 80GB + ability to burst to additional H100s during peaks
- Estimated sustainable throughput: ~4k tokens/sec aggregate; lower variance
- Expected P95 latency: ~180–260ms
- Estimated list cost: $22k/month (reserved + burst buffer pricing)
- Implied unit cost: ~ $7–$9 per 1M tokens depending on utilization and burst pattern

Notes / assumptions:
- Estimates assume quantized FP16 or Q4 models and typical prefix caching for assistant flows.
- If you can commit to a 12-month reserved term we can push the $/1M token lower (I can model 12/24 month discounts).
- We’ll run a short benchmark with a sample prompt set to validate latency and tokens/sec before finalizing.

I’ve attached a short PDF that lays out capacity vs cost tradeoffs (capacity-options.pdf). Happy to jump on the call tomorrow morning to align.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin | Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Alex / Marcus —

Great options — appreciate the quick turnaround, Marcus. Proposed next steps so we can move toward a formal proposal: 

1) Alex: confirm preference between Option A (cost-first A100) and Option B (performance-first H100) or indicate willingness to pilot Option B for a month.
2) Marcus: send a 1-page benchmark plan (sample prompts + target qps/latency) and a 12/24-month discount model for both options.
3) Marissa: I’ll schedule a 30-min procurement + technical alignment call for Thu 10:00 AM PT and prepare a short MA P in HubSpot.
